程序化参照结构 · 非标本扫描: Procedural reference · not a specimen scan
一片叶子，也是一整个世界。: A whole world inside a single leaf.
紧密的栅栏下面，是有空隙的海绵组织。: Beneath the packed palisade cells lies spongy tissue with air spaces.
一摞摞基粒，被薄薄的膜连在一起。: Thin membranes connect stacks of grana.
细胞形状、细胞器位置是按尺寸生成的参照，不是真实扫描。: Cell shapes and organelle positions are references generated to scale, not specimen scans.
小细胞器快速流动，叶绿体用几分钟挪向合适的光。: Small organelles stream quickly. Chloroplasts take minutes to find suitable light.
环流太快，显示为轨迹: Streaming is too fast; shown as trails
叶绿体要几分钟才挪完，把时间调到 ×60 看看。: Chloroplasts take minutes to move. Try setting time to ×60.
细胞壁切口显示为 0.4 μm，是 0.2 μm 参考壁厚的 2 倍；截面层切边: The cell-wall cut is shown at 0.4 μm, twice the 0.2 μm reference thickness. In the leaf section, the 0.65 μm cut band is enlarged about 3.25 times.
聚光与避光阈值借鉴拟南芥光迁移研究，是简化的白光阈值，不是菠菜实测。叶绿体移动约: Accumulation and avoidance use simplified white-light thresholds informed by Arabidopsis studies, not measurements in spinach. Chloroplasts move about 1–3 μm per minute.
淀粉按正净碳同化的 25% 储存；黑暗中按预计夜长消耗。百分比相对于模型参考容量: Starch stores 25% of positive net carbon assimilation and is used over the expected night. Percentages refer to a model capacity, not leaf dry weight.
16.3–19.1 nm 的类囊体间距取自拟南芥暗适应与强光实验，按光强分档插值: The 16.3–19.1 nm thylakoid spacing comes from dark-adapted and high-light Arabidopsis experiments, interpolated in light-intensity bands.
膜上的分子各有位置。电子一路走，质子留在腔里。: Each molecule has its place in the membrane. Electrons pass along; protons collect in the lumen.
转子转一圈，14 个质子通过，3 个 ATP 离开。: One rotor turn passes 14 protons and releases 3 ATP.
电子传递以约 1/1000 的局部慢放示意；亮点代表传递事件，不是粒子轨道。: Electron transfer is shown locally at about 1/1000 speed. Glints represent transfer events, not particle paths.
分子运动已加快；亮点与轨迹示意事件密度，不逐个追踪真实电子。: Molecular motion is sped up. Glints and trails show event density, without tracking individual electrons.
黑暗中，γ 亚基的氧化还原开关锁住转子。: In darkness, the γ subunit’s redox switch locks the rotor.
铜色转子逆时针转动（从基质侧看）；外面的定子不动。: The copper rotor turns counterclockwise as viewed from the stroma. The surrounding stator stays still.
高速时转动显示限于每秒 2 圈；局部倍率按实际显示速度计算。: Displayed rotation is capped at 2 turns per second. The local slow-motion factor reflects the displayed speed.
PDB 实验结构 · 排布与运动为示意: Experimental PDB structures · arrangement and motion are illustrative
分子来自 PDB 实验结构，大多为菠菜；光系统 I 来自豌豆。膜上排布按分区与拥: Molecules use experimental PDB structures, mostly from spinach; photosystem I is from pea. Membrane placement reflects regional organization and crowding, not an electron-microscopy reconstruction.
分子过程采用局部慢放。ATP 合酶转速是百圈每秒的数量级参照，不是菠菜在该光强下: Molecular processes use local slow motion. ATP synthase speed is an order-of-magnitude reference of about 100 turns per second, not a spinach measurement at this light intensity. L5 adjusts the slow-motion factor for visible rotation.

铁氧还蛋白 1A70 是菠菜 E92K 突变体，用作形状参照；它不代表野生型电子: Ferredoxin 1A70 is the spinach E92K mutant, used as a shape reference. It does not represent the wild-type electron-transfer rate.
叶绿体正在慢慢挪位，需要几分钟。: Chloroplasts are moving slowly. This takes a few minutes.
黑暗中消耗淀粉，缓慢移向底部和侧壁。: Using starch in darkness; slowly moving toward the bottom and side walls.
缓慢移向侧壁，减少强光照射。: Slowly relocating to side walls to reduce exposure to strong light.
进行光合作用，缓慢调整向光位置。: Photosynthesizing while slowly adjusting its position toward the light.
进行呼吸作用，随胞质流移动并翻转。: Respiring while moving and tumbling with cytoplasmic flow.
参与光呼吸和氧化物代谢，常在叶绿体旁停留。: Participating in photorespiration and peroxide metabolism; often pausing near chloroplasts.
加工和分拣分子，沿胞质索走走停停。: Processing and sorting molecules; moving intermittently along cytoplasmic strands.
在膜网络上合成和运输蛋白与脂质。: Synthesizing and transporting proteins and lipids through its membrane network.
保存遗传信息，核孔连接核内外运输。: Storing genetic information; nuclear pores mediate transport across the envelope.
沿着叶脉向里走。这片菠菜叶，连接着我们即将看到的细胞和分子。: Follow the veins inward. This spinach leaf connects the cells and molecules we are about to explore.
两枚保卫细胞围出一个孔。气孔调节气体交换，也影响水分散失。: Two guard cells surround a pore. Stomata regulate gas exchange and water loss.
紧密的栅栏组织朝向阳光，下面的海绵组织留下连通的气腔。: Dense palisade tissue faces the sunlight. Spongy tissue below leaves connected air spaces.
小细胞器沿胞质索流动。叶绿体留在壁边，用几分钟调整向光的位置。: Small organelles travel along cytoplasmic strands. Chloroplasts stay near the wall and take minutes to adjust to light.
一摞摞类囊体组成基粒，伸出的薄膜把它们连接起来。: Stacks of thylakoids form grana, joined by thin connecting membranes.
光系统让电子接力前进，把质子积累到腔内。伸向基质的大分子只能站在空隙足够的膜面。: Photosystems relay electrons and build up protons in the lumen. Bulky stromal heads require enough room above the membrane.
铜色转子转一圈通过 14 个质子，三个催化位点释放 3 个 ATP。关灯，它会锁: Fourteen protons pass per turn of the copper rotor, and three catalytic sites release three ATP. Switch off the light and the rotor locks.
干旱过程压缩至 3 个模拟小时；×60 下约 3 分钟。: Drought is compressed to 3 simulated hours: about 3 minutes at ×60.
实验：叶片浸入 0.5 M NaCl，外液进入壁膜间隙。: Experiment: immersion in 0.5 M NaCl; external solution fills the wall–membrane gap.
水势与体积为压力–体积参照模型。干旱压缩至 3 小时，复水约 30 分钟；盐水交: Water potential and volume use a reference pressure–volume model. Drought takes 3 compressed hours, rehydration about 30 minutes, and salt exchange about 5 minutes. Parameters are not fitted to a spinach cultivar; wall collapse and plasmolysis shapes are schematic.
原生质体收缩后，外面的盐水填入壁与膜之间；不是空气。: As the protoplast shrinks, external saline fills the gap between wall and membrane.
质膜仍在这些点连接细胞壁，被拉成细丝。: The plasma membrane remains attached to the wall here, stretching into fine strands.
光合曲线是参照模型；放氧按净碳同化估算，未单独计算光呼吸。气孔的光响应时间常数为: The photosynthesis curve is a reference model. Oxygen is estimated from net carbon assimilation without separate photorespiration. Stomatal light responses have a 15-minute time constant; water-stress closure uses 1 minute.
